top_signals.title: How Ukraine’s data centre strikes threw Russia into turmoil
top_signals.summary: Kyiv’s attacks exposed vulnerabilities of Kremlin effort to centralise internet services under one company
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Hongkong Land Said to Eye Stake in Tycoon’s Singapore Assets
top_signals.summary: Hongkong Land Holdings Ltd. is in discussions with Ong Beng Seng’s Hotel Properties Ltd. to buy a majority stake in three buildings in Singapore’s Orchard Road shopping belt, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Germany puts Ukrainian ex-officer in the dock over Nord Stream sabotage
top_signals.summary: Serhii Kuznietsov is accused of leading group of divers who placed explosives on the Russian gas pipelines in the Baltic Sea
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered expands Bitcoin and Ether trading to professional investors in UAE
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered expanded its spot crypto trading services to professional investors in the UAE region, with plans to offer access to more market participants.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: BHP, Escondida Workers Near Deal to Avert Copper Mine Strike
top_signals.summary: A deal to avert a strike at BHP Group’s Escondida in Chile is “virtually done,” according to a union leader, signaling a breakthrough in eleventh-hour wage talks at the world’s biggest copper mine.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: India’s Wealth Fund Eyes $800 Million Data Center Push
top_signals.summary: India’s quasi-sovereign wealth fund is planning to invest up to $800 million in data centers and related businesses, seeking to expand in the space after drawing billions in added investments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Patrick Drahi’s creditors strike back
top_signals.summary: Lenders have sued Altice International in the latest escalation of a long-running battle between the heavily indebted telecoms group and its creditors

top_signals.summary: Developers can now build XRPL wallets into apps via Privy, with support for XRP, RLUSD, AI agent payments and x402.
